35个典型案例具体包括张警官人工智能体+思维体、AI智能制造助推企业高质量发展、: The 35 typical cases specifically include Zhang Police Officer Artificial Intelligence Entity Plus Cognitive Framework, AI Intelligent Manufacturing Driving Enterprise High-Quality Development, Online Intelligent Diagnosis of Full Lifecycle of Compound Semiconductor Materials Based on Artificial Intelligence, 'Xiong Little Farmer' AI Agricultural Large Model, and Intelligent Monitoring and Regulation of Natural Resources Across Space, Sky and Ground.
截至目前，河北省通过中央网信办备案大模型13款，已在钢铁、化工等26个领域开发3: To date, Hebei Province has filed 13 large models through the Central Cyberspace Administration, and has developed 365 vertical large models in 26 sectors such as steel and chemical industries.
全省正在推进实施“人工智能+”行动计划，重点在钢铁、化工、农业、教育、医药健康等: The province is implementing the 'Artificial Intelligence Plus' Action Plan, focusing on developing innovative application scenarios in 15 industries including steel, chemicals, agriculture, education, and pharmaceutical health, building an artificial intelligence native application innovation ecosystem with Hebei characteristics, and promoting the integration and application of artificial intelligence with key industries and sectors in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region.
